accessibility.text: 1. It is possible for all people to have free will and yet never bring about any evil.
2. God can bring about any possible situation.
C. God could have made a world where all people have free will and yet never bring about any evil. (1,2)

If the conclusion of this argument is true, then no evil can be explained by the good of human free will, since that good could have existence without the evil. In this case, the free will defense gives us no cause to reject premise (9*).
